working_tree_semantics: Round 5B was implemented and verified in the current uncommitted worktree rooted at the exact activated Round 9.1 clean baseline. The pre-existing user edit to the Round 10 specification was preserved. No file was staged, committed, or pushed, and Round 10 orchestration, provider-error reactive compaction, Web/Desktop UI, memory extraction, or a durable compaction recovery graph was not implemented.

contracts.cold_epoch_assembler: one pure KernelColdEpochInputAssembler shared by ordinary cold open and CompactionContinuationSeed; SubagentInitialSeed remains a retained Round 10 consumer contract only

implementation.summary: The current primary model receives the exact old native replay prefix with the old tool surface and explicit tool_choice=auto. Active/idle prompts state that summary-only no-tool restrictions end with that response and cannot become queued/deferred task state. No ProcessLocalToolSurfaceBorrow, tool callback, continuity permit, or canonical assistant acceptance is available; a model-selected tool call receives at most one ephemeral denial repair and is never dispatched.
implementation.adoption: PreparedCompactionCanonicalAdoption atomically accepts the snapshot, binding revision and CompactionAdopted occurrence. The closed carrier durably stores RESUME_ACTIVE_TURN or AWAIT_NEXT_USER, a complete Runtime handoff instruction and the mechanical active-request location. FULL/NONE/CONFLICT confirmation covers the exact row composite; active settlement installs one standard EMPTY cold successor and idle settlement survives Host restart while waiting for a future user-driven cold open.
implementation.protected_material: At most three complete pairing-safe tool groups, recent exact human input, current bounded Runtime handoff and eligible retained Skill bodies are recompiled after the snapshot without rewriting the canonical transcript.
implementation.capability_rebase: The successor consumes the activated Round 9 parent dispatch cut and sibling Tool/Skill views, EmptyCapabilityEpochPredecessor, two-stage selection/native materialization, FrozenToolCapabilityExposurePlan, FrozenNonTriggerContextSources, PreparedKernelToolSurface and ProcessLocalToolSurfaceBorrow. A complete MCP cohort is all DIRECT or all META_ONLY.
implementation.skill_rebase: SKILL_CATALOG comes from current owner discovery; same-activation ACTIVE_SKILL is inherited from the old installed exact snapshot. RETAINED_SKILL_CONTEXT is derived only from exact same-run ordinary COMPLETE/FULL installed reads, or the immediately installed retained predecessor, after current manifest revalidation.
implementation.strict_prefix: Every old epoch and every successor epoch independently keeps SYSTEM and tools exact and messages append-only. Compaction is the explicit cold epoch boundary; it never mutates an installed prefix.
implementation.job_subtraction: BACKGROUND_COMPACTION, the job executor/model/catalog, durable_jobs, durable_job_attempts, three job occurrences, two job subjects and JobClaimGuard were removed. No replacement receipt, checkpoint, repair, replay worker, or durable compaction owner was added.

pytest_node_inventory.disposition: All removed nodes are obsolete durable-job tests or old job-shaped seams. Their exact IDs and every activated node ID are stored in the referenced inventory; replacement architecture, schema, ordering and compaction nodes are in the added set.
